Find the difference between the sum of all composite numbers from 41 to 53 and the sum of all prime numbers from 10 to 30.

41 से 53 तक सभी भाज्य संख्याओं के योग तथा 10 से 30 तक सभी अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग के बीच का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
The composite numbers from 41 to 53 = 42, 44, 45, 46, 48, 49, 50, 51, 52

The sum of all the composite numbers from 41 to 53 = 42 + 44 + 45 + 46 + 48 + 49 + 50 + 51 + 52 = 427

The prime numbers from 10 to 30 = 11, 13, 17, 19, 23, 29

The sum of all the prime numbers from 10 to 30 = 11 + 13 + 17 + 19 + 23 + 29 = 112

Hence, the required difference = 427 - 112 = 315

questions.q:
Three stacks of notebooks contain 288, 432, and 576 notebooks. The notebooks are to be arranged in equal-sized piles. What is the largest number of notebooks per pile, and how many piles will be there in total?

नोटबुक के तीन ढेरों में क्रमशः 288, 432 और 576 नोटबुक हैं। इन नोटबुक को बराबर आकार के ढेरों में व्यवस्थित किया जाना है। प्रत्येक ढेर में नोटबुक की अधिकतम संख्या क्या है और कुल कितने ढेर होंगे?
questions.s:
Factor of 288 = 25 * 32

Factor of 432 = 24 * 33

Factor of 576 = 26 * 32

HCF = 24 * 32 = 16 * 9 = 144

288/144 = 2 piles

432/144 = 3 piles

576/144 = 4 piles

Total number of piles = 2 + 3 + 4 = 9 piles

questions.q:
A fruit vendor has a number of apples. If he tries to pack them in groups of 3, 4, 6 or 9, there are 2 apples left. But if he packs them in groups of 7, there are none left. Find the least number of apples he has.

एक फल विक्रेता के पास कई सेब हैं। अगर वह उन्हें 3, 4, 6 या 9 के समूहों में पैक करता है, तो 2 सेब बचते हैं। लेकिन अगर वह उन्हें 7 के समूहों में पैक करता है, तो एक भी सेब नहीं बचता। उसके पास सेबों की सबसे कम संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.s:
LCM of 3, 4, 6 and 9 = 36

Least number(N) = 36k + 2

N ≡ 0 (mod 7)

36k + 2 ≡ 0 (mod 7)

36k ≡ - 2 ≡ 5(mod 7)

Now reduce 36 mod 7

36/7 = 5 remainder 1, so 36 ≡ 1 mod 7

So the equation becomes

1k ≡ 5 (mod 7)

k ≡ 5 (mod 7)

take smallest k = 5

N = 36 * 5 + 2 = 182 (when divided by 3, 4, 6 and 9 leaves remainder 2)

questions.q:
If x is an odd number and y is an even number, then which of the following is an odd number?

यदि x एक विषम संख्या है और y एक सम संख्या है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक विषम संख्या है?
questions.s:
x = odd, so let x = 2n + 1, where n is any positive integer

y = even, so let y = 2m, where m is any positive integer

x + y + 1 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 1 = 2n + 2m + 2 = 2(n + m + 1), which is even

xy = (2n + 1)2m = 2m(2n + 1), which is even

xy + y = 2m(2n + 1) + 2m = 2m(2n + 2), which is even

x + y + 2 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 2 = 2n + 2m + 3 = 2(n + m + 1) + 1, so it is odd.

LCM of 3, 4, 6 and 9 = 36

Least number(N) = 36k + 2

N ≡ 0 (mod 7)

36k + 2 ≡ 0 (mod 7)

36k ≡ - 2 ≡ 5(mod 7)

Now reduce 36 mod 7

36/7 = 5 remainder 1, so 36 ≡ 1 mod 7

So the equation becomes

1k ≡ 5 (mod 7)

k ≡ 5 (mod 7)

take smallest k = 5

N = 36 * 5 + 2 = 182 (when divided by 3, 4, 6 and 9 leaves remainder 2)

questions_hin.q_hi:
If x is an odd number and y is an even number, then which of the following is an odd number?

यदि x एक विषम संख्या है और y एक सम संख्या है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक विषम संख्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
x = odd, so let x = 2n + 1, where n is any positive integer

y = even, so let y = 2m, where m is any positive integer

x + y + 1 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 1 = 2n + 2m + 2 = 2(n + m + 1), which is even

xy = (2n + 1)2m = 2m(2n + 1), which is even

xy + y = 2m(2n + 1) + 2m = 2m(2n + 2), which is even

x + y + 2 = 2n + 1 + 2m + 2 = 2n + 2m + 3 = 2(n + m + 1) + 1, so it is odd.

questions_hin.q_hi:
How many whole numbers are there between 109 and 345 which are exactly divisible by 11?

109 और 345 के बीच कितनी पूर्ण संख्याएँ हैं जो 11 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हैं?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Smallest number divisible by 11 between 109 and 345 = 110

Largest number divisible by 11 between 109 and 345 = 341

Formed an A.P. with a = 110, d = 11 and an = 341

an = a + (n - 1)d

341 = 110 + (n - 1)11

231 = 11n - 11

11n = 242

n = 22

questions_hin.q_hi:
If 3A65B is divisible by 11, then what is the value of B - A?

यदि 3A65B, 11 से विभाज्य है, तो B - A का मान कितना है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
Given number = 3A65B

Sum of digits at even places = A + 5

Sum of digits at odd places = 9 + B

Difference = 9 + B - A - 5 = B - A + 4

Now, to be the divisible by 11, the value of B - A should be 7.

Therefore, B - A = 7

questions_hin.q_hi: 5. वह एक अंक की सबसे छोटी संख्या बताइए, जिसे 6 अंकों की संख्या 950473 में जोड़ने पर संख्या 11 से पूर्णतः विभाज्य हो जाए।
questions_hin.s_hi:
5.(a) 11 का विभाज्यता नियम = यदि विषम स्थानों के अंकों के योग और सम स्थानों के अंकों के योग के बीच का अंतर या तो 0 है या 11 का गुणक है
दी गई संख्या = 950473
इसके विषम स्थान के अंकों का योग = 9 + 0 + 7 = 16
इसके सम स्थान के अंकों का योग = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12
अंतर = 16 - 12 = 4
∴ यदि हमने इस नंबर में 4 जोड़े तो यह संख्या 11 से विभाज्य होगा।

questions_hin.q_hi:
Find the LCM of a3+b3 and c3+d3, where a= 5, b= 4, c=10 and d=2.

a3+b3 और c3+d3 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए, जहाँ a= 5, b= 4, c=10 और d=2 है।
questions_hin.s_hi:
According to the Question,

LCM of a3+b3 and c3+d3

Given that: a= 5, b= 4, c=10 and d=2

a3+b3 = 53+43 = 125 + 64 = 189

c3+d3 = 103+23 = 1000 + 8 = 1008

Now, LCM of 189 and 1008 is to be determined

Factors of 189 = 3 x 3 x 3 x 7

Factors of 1008 = 2x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 7

So, LCM = 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 x 3 x 3 x 7= 3024

questions_hin.q_hi:
The L.C.M. of 2 * 32 * 53 * 7, 25 * 32 * 52 * 11 and 23 * 35 * 5 * 7 * 11 is -

2 * 32 * 53 * 7, 25 * 32 * 52 * 11 तथा 23 * 35 * 5 * 7 * 11 का लघुत्तम समापवर्त्य है -
questions_hin.s_hi:
For LCM, we take the highest power.

Taking the highest power of each digit -

Highest power of 2 = 5

Highest power of 3 = 5

Highest power of 5 = 3

Highest power of 7 = 1

Highest power of 11 = 1

LCM = 25 * 35 * 53 * 7 * 11

What is the difference between the sum of prime numbers between 30 and 40 to the sum of prime number between 40 and 50?

30 और 40 के बीच अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग तथा 40 और 50 के बीच अभाज्य संख्याओं के योग में क्या अंतर है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
For perfect cube, number of zeroes should be 3, 6, 9 etc.

(a) 1000000, since it has 6 zeroes, so cube root = 103

(b) 2160000 - 4 zeroes

(c) 194000 = 194 * 1000 => 194 is not a perfect cube)

(d) 12500000 - 5 zeroes

Hence, option 'a' is correct.
